cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Reverse the Score
cards.instruction: Turn each apparent loss into a new category of victory, then invite comparison on those changing terms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The small trophy is better. It shows restraint. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. How gracefully can your enormous cup fit in a cupboard?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And mine doesn't need to shout. Another victory in modesty.
